$comment: Per-file budgets for served public assets. Measured baseline 2026-10-10 (raw/gzip bytes): islands admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2483/1213, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092 (re-measured 2026-10-21 after the stale-qualification + aggregate-only retry slice: 4244/1775, ceilings 5632/2304 = measured x1.25 rounded up for the stale note/retry signal, focus ownership and retry read path, not bloat), join-widget 574/376 (new, ceilings 1024/512; re-measured after focus-on-load + guided-fallback behavior: 1185/593, ceilings 1536/768 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the load/error/timeout handlers and the invite-fallback message, not bloat), member-profile 9471/3500 (re-measured 2026-10-12 after merging main: field-error association plus main #709 unsaved-draft warning, #722 focus and #752 progress feedback; ceiling 12288/4608 = measured x1.25 rounded up), past-events 3602/1490, rsvp-button 14498/4201, model-context 2593/1195 (new, ceilings 3584/1536), attendees-live 4494/1660 (new, ceilings 4608/1792; measured after the non-rotating fragment header, attendee-page preservation and the stale-note/focus review fixes; re-measured 4789/1811 after the same-event document admission gate, ceilings 5120/2048 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the mount-key check, not bloat); styles 4749/1611 (esbuild 0.28.1 --minify from assets/); theme 11965/2776, theme-tokens 1204/330, event-theme 5688/1462, profile-theme 6528/1518, schedule-theme 3932/1197 (authored in public/, no assets/ source). The auth-status gzip ceiling uses the repository's x1.25 rule on its 2026-10-10 baseline (1213 -> 1536 B) to cover two approved fail-safe auth changes: bounded sign-out feedback and the session-read deadline when abort is ignored; raw ceiling is unchanged. Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B). Earlier history: minified baseline 2026-10-03 admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2081/1009, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, member-profile 6138/2414, past-events 3350/1397, rsvp-button 13662/4001, styles 4749/1611; baseline 2026-09-30 events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth and every top-level public/*.css file must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. assets/ holds the reviewed sources for islands and styles.css; public/ holds the deterministic build output for those (node ci/minify-assets.mjs --check fails on drift). Theme stylesheets are served as authored. Served behavior is unchanged: the binder suite executes the minified bytes. schedule-theme raw ceiling 5632 covers the measured clean-text merge 5444/1468 (calendar month-jump plus member-board/archive growth) with one 512B raw step; gzip ceiling is unchanged at 1536 per the auth-status precedent. 2026-10-20 reconciliation (calendar subscription help merge current main): the merge-base file is 4621B; this PR's subscription-help disclosure rules (+489B to 5110B) and main's viewer-row sticky/aria-current/forced-colors plus archive-state rules (+491B to 5112B) each fit the 5120B ceiling alone, but the combined authored file measures 5601B raw (CI identical), 481B over. The selector sets are disjoint, so no consolidation is available without changing either reviewed feature's presentation; theme stylesheets are served as authored with no minify step. Only the breached raw ceiling moves, one 512B step to 5632B (31B margin; deterministic authored bytes, so no rebuild wobble). Deliberately far below x1.25 (7168B). Gzip (1509/1536B) and every other ceiling stay fixed and fail-closed. No gate skipped or disabled. 2026-10-21 calendar month-jump merge: the island and schedule-theme each fit alone on both sides (island main 6568/2479, PR 6649/2420; CSS main 5601/1499, PR 5444/1468) but the clean-text merge measures 7180/2639 and 5933/1549, breaching both ceilings with no other conflict. The merges combine disjoint reviewed features: island = month-jump rewire + main-side auth-href sync; CSS = month-jump controls including required 44px touch sizing + main-side subscription-help/member-board rules. Only these two ceilings move, by minimal steps: island 6656/2560 to 7680/2816 (7168 would still be 12B short raw, so 7680 is the minimal 512B step; gzip +1x256B step), CSS 5632/1536 to 6144/1792 (minimal +512B/+256B steps). Deliberately far below x1.25 (island 9216/3328; CSS 7680/2048). Every other ceiling stays fixed and fail-closed. 2026-10-21 C3 model-context bounds: measured 3716/1711 after the per-call 10s deadline, 32 KiB body cap, coded failures, bounded Retry-After and pagehide composition; ceilings 4096/1792 = one 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the bounds machinery, per the join-widget and auth-status fail-safe precedent. Deliberately far below x1.25 (5120/2304). Lean-to-fit alternatives (single message template, shared error paths, 404 folded into unavailable) are already in; further cuts trade stable codes and honest guidance for bytes with near-zero margin, so the step carries the approved behavior instead of contorting it. 2026-10-21 C3 review round: measured 4463/2013 after settle-owned abort plus pendingReads/listener release, streaming byte-cap enforcement with reader cancel, and honest 404 not_found mapping; ceilings 4608/2048 = one more 512B raw / 256B gzip step for the review-mandated cleanup and streaming machinery, per the same fail-safe precedent. Deliberately far below x1.25 (5632/2560). Micro-opts already in (shared cancel/release paths, byteLength-only counting, try-guarded cleanup); further cuts trade early-abort and leak-freedom for bytes with 145B raw / 35B gzip margin, so the step carries the approved reliability instead of contorting it. 2026-10-21 schedule-cancellation merge: this branch's cancelled-grid badge stacking rules (+167B raw over the merge-base file: column flex for [data-cal-jump][data-cancelled] plus badge margin) combine additively with main's month-jump/subscription-help/member-board rules; after the Display fallback merge the authored file measures 5788/1553B, inside the existing 6144/1792B ceilings (356B/239B margin per npm run budget), so no ceiling moves.
